bio: Donavan Deante McKinney (born June 16, 1992) is an American politician serving as a member of the Michigan House of Representatives since 2023, currently representing the 11th district. A member of the Democratic Party and the Democratic Socialists of America, McKinney is the member-elect for Michigan's 13th congressional district in 2026.
